description: This file is a Kotlin source file that defines a Composable function CanvasScreen which creates and manages an AndroidView with a WebView for displaying web content within a Jetpack Compose UI. It includes configurations for WebView settings, event handlers for page load and errors, and a JavaScript interface for communication between web content and Kotlin code.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionBridge
classes.description: A JavaScript interface class that provides a method to post messages from web content to the host application, with a trust check.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: JavaScript interface method to receive messages from web content, with trust verification.
